title: Speaking — Changes in the neighbourhood
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on changes in the neighbourhood.

questions: What did you last use your phone for?
When do you prefer to put your phone away?
Which phone feature do you find especially useful?
Has your phone changed how you arrange to meet people?
How long have you known the area where you live?
Which places in your area have changed most recently?

part2.topic: Describe a change near your home that you welcomed.
part2.closing: and explain why you personally welcomed the change.

questions: How should residents be consulted about building projects?
Why can improvements to a neighbourhood also create difficulties for some residents?
How has everyday life connected with changes in the neighbourhood changed for people of different ages?
